scope: 58 cohorts of 2,048 proteins; individual alignment plots cover the five highlighted cohorts; raw PPPL download covers all 58.
family_PPPL_definition: exp(-mean of available per-protein mean log probabilities); each available protein has equal weight.
estimate_note: Incomplete ESM3 family values are estimates from a nonrandom subset, not final or unbiased family scores. Individual protein scores are measured, not imputed.
alignment_source: Archived original-order Qwen3-14B cosine k=10 neighbor overlap; no alignment rerun. Family alignment uses all 2048 members even when PPPL is partial.
comparability_note: PPPL probability scales differ by model; compare associations within models.
